ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) central pixels to high-intensity (white/light grey) lateral tip pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity contiguous mass centered at the fluke hub extending to the mid-lobes. Discrete high-intensity zones on the distal tips of both lobes. The right distal tip contains multiple isolated low-intensity circular blobs (spots) within the high-intensity field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees; notch depth reaches approximately 12% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency irregular serration pattern across both lobes; vertical amplitude of variations ranges from 2 to 8 pixels relative to the local mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Initial concave curvature exiting the median notch, transitioning into a broad convex curve that tapers to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of four distinct, roughly circular low-intensity clusters on the high-intensity background of the right lobe tip. Scattered high-intensity micro-clusters (white spots) located on the lower-left dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single high-intensity linear pixel disruption (scratch) approximately 40 pixels in length, oriented diagonally in the lower-left quadrant of the dark central mass.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced linear white scar on the ventral left lobe; irregular jagged fraying on the right distal trailing edge compared to the left.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'constellation' pattern of four dark spots on the right distal tip which serves as a highly localized identifier.
